<!-- Code: nn_timeline.layers.attention.AdditiveAttention, DotProductAttention -->
<!-- Next: ../02_transformer/01_self_attention.qmd -->
<!-- Timeline anchor: Bahdanau et al. 2015 (additive), Luong et al. 2015 (multiplicative). -->

::: {.callout-tip title="TL;DR" icon="false"}
The Seq2Seq bottleneck — one fixed context vector for the entire source
sentence — is broken by **attention**: a dynamic weighted sum over all
encoder states, recomputed at each decoding step.
**Additive attention** (Bahdanau, 2015) learns a small MLP to score
alignment; **multiplicative attention** (Luong, 2015) replaces it with a
dot product. The dot product scales to the Transformer's scaled
dot-product attention unchanged.
:::

**Depends on:** [Seq2Seq RNN Encoder-Decoder](03_seq2seq.qmd)
